rules.description: Any unresolved exploitable security, privilege, signature, secret, or supply-chain issue blocks every wave.
Any unresolved data-loss, residue, rollback, crash-loop, or ownership failure blocks every wave.
A reviewed private vulnerability-reporting channel is required.
Public privacy/security/support text requires the recorded human reviews.
The production App feed and Sparkle trust root must be provisioned and verified.
The production Core endpoints and independent Ed25519 keyring must be provisioned and verified.
A candidate cannot claim the Release contract while the required CLI, Automation protocol, and Scene schema are absent.
The immutable Release manifest must bind the exact approved architecture-freeze SHA.
Authentic V0.1 through V0.7 generated migration fixtures and idempotency evidence are required.
No absolute performance ceiling is enforceable until a reference machine is calibrated and approved.
External audit and verification of Critical/High findings are required.
A real uninterrupted 24-hour Beta soak with passing cleanup is required.
A real uninterrupted 72-hour RC soak with passing cleanup is required.
Signed physical-machine multi-user ownership and privacy evidence is required.
Signed, dedicated-machine TUN/System Proxy transition and residue evidence is required.
The candidate artifact must be Developer ID signed, notarized, and stapled.
The final artifact, release manifest, SBOM, and available provenance must agree; GitHub attestation is required only when produced by the protected GitHub workflow.
A critical accessibility blocker in a main flow is Stop-Ship.
A regression over an approved comparable-machine budget is Stop-Ship.
Owned TUN, route, or system proxy residue is Stop-Ship.
Data loss, silent discard, or non-idempotent migration is Stop-Ship.
Any App/Core update or code-signing trust failure is Stop-Ship.
